Akshay Kumar's 'Welcome to the Jungle' Box Office Performance Detailed

Akshay Kumar's film 'Welcome to the Jungle' has achieved a worldwide gross of over Rs 100 crore. Reports indicate varied box office performance, with some noting a significant drop in collection on Monday, while others highlight growth on Tuesday and breaking previous records. The film's budget is reported to be Rs 125 crore, with shooting completed in 75 shifts.
